question: Why did nnU-Net stop saving model checkpoints as pickle files?
evidence: commit: .pth is a pickle and torch.load(weights_only=False) runs any code in it; PR #3011: CVE-2025-32434, portability

question: Why did downloading the pretrained v1 models from Zenodo break?
evidence: PR #3017: forcing HTTP/1.0 made Zenodo return 404 instead of redirecting; issue #2876 is the report

question: Why did a second user get a permission error when training into a shared results folder?
evidence: PR #3016: shutil.copy also copies permission bits via chmod; issue #2882 is the report

question: Why could the same segmentation get different label boundaries after resampling with torch versus numpy?
evidence: commit: even-factor resampling makes 50/50 ties that were broken by label value, differently on each path

question: Why were the foreground sampling coordinates moved out of each case's pickle file?
evidence: commit: the dataloader read and unpickled every coordinate to use one; dominated IO on many-class datasets

question: Why was writing the sampling store so slow on a cluster's parallel file system?
evidence: commit: blosc2 pays ~16 ms per chunk on GPFS (vs 0.09 ms locally) when appending

question: Why do inference processes start up faster now?
evidence: commit: seaborn/pyplot/sklearn imported lazily; ~0.8 s saved per process

question: Why did computing Dice and the other evaluation metrics get faster?
evidence: commit: one confusion matrix per case instead of ~15 passes per class

question: Why did training on the CHAOS dataset put scans of the same patient into different folds?
evidence: commit: the split was saved as splits_final.pkl, which v2 does not read, so a random split was used

question: Why are saved nrrd segmentations so much smaller than they used to be?
evidence: PR #1720: SimpleITK writer compression turned on (20 MB vs 19 kB)

question: Why couldn't the DA5 trainer be used for multi-GPU training before?
evidence: PR #1788: lambdas in nnUNetTrainerDA5 blocked multi-GPU training

question: Why is it easier now to turn deep supervision off in a custom trainer?
evidence: PR #1740: deep supervision was half-static; now a self.enable_deep_supervision attribute

question: Why does nnU-Net check that unpacked .npy files can actually be read?
evidence: PR #1628: broken extractions only failed later, when the bad case was sampled

question: Why did intensity normalization become much faster on very large CT scans?
evidence: PR #1889: fewer allocations (astype copy=False, in-place ops), up to 20x faster on 512^3

question: Why was the code that creates the mixed-precision gradient scaler changed?
evidence: PR #2684: torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler is deprecated in favour of torch.GradScaler("cuda")

question: Why did resolving all optional extras pull in torch<2.3 and numpy<2 on Linux?
evidence: PR #3043: the intel_macos extra pinned them without a platform marker

question: Why was the default patch size changed?
evidence: commit subject: the 2D patch size was unintentionally capped at 512 with the default configuration

question: Why does nnunetv2 still depend on the imagecodecs package?
evidence: maintainer in #2899: needed for reading and writing compressed tif files; PR #2992 tried to remove it as unused

question: Why does nnU-Net resample images with cubic interpolation by default instead of linear?
evidence: maintainer in #2082: bicubic can give better results; switch to linear if CPU-bound, minimal drop

question: Why don't some datasets get a 3d_lowres configuration?
evidence: maintainer in #1360: if 3d_fullres already sees the whole image there is no point in 3d_lowres and the cascade

question: Where does the gradient clipping value of 12 come from?
evidence: maintainer in #1224: optimized long ago; only there to prevent rare NaN problems

question: Why does the dataloader's sampling bounding box extend past the image borders?
evidence: maintainer in #2025: the initially sampled patch is larger than the training patch (refers to "my response in the other issue", possibly #2021)

question: Why did the benchmark trainer report "Not enough VRAM" on a GPU with plenty of memory?
evidence: PR #3020: the logging swallowed the real error (a Triton/inductor failure)

question: Why did nnU-Net move from PyTorch to JAX?
evidence: never happened; JAX only appears in an unrelated user error (#2180) and a portability remark in #3011

question: Why was TensorFlow support removed?
evidence: nnU-Net never had TensorFlow support; only incidental mentions

question: Why was the default optimizer switched to AdamW?
evidence: the default is still SGD; AdamW only appears in users' custom trainers (#2743, #2853)

question: Why was nnU-Net relicensed under the MIT license?
evidence: no record mentions a licence change

question: Why was Windows support dropped?
evidence: never dropped; Windows only appears in fixes such as disabling blosc2 memmap on Windows

question: Why was a web-based annotation tool added?
evidence: no such tool in the history

question: Why was the residual encoder (ResEnc) architecture added?
evidence: ResEnc presets exist, but no record says why: users only link to documentation/resenc_presets.md, which is not part of the indexed history

question: Why did the preprocessed data format switch to blosc2?
evidence: blosc2 appears in many fixes and install problems, but no record states the reason for adopting it
